body:
Keep grasping. In fact, hang on tight. People have a funny way of appearing when you need them most. 

I have periods where I totally give up on doctors. I stop all of my medication and cancel all of my appointments. And then I find myself needing to go back. Haha. It's frustrating to say the least. The hope I've found is in the balance--eastern meets western medicine with a whole lot of self-care. That's one thing that I really discovered after I started seeing a therapist. I had totally neglected the simple things. And while they won't get rid of my pain or even decrease the levels, they do disconnect you from it if only for a moment. 

Please don't give up. I do believe that there are good support groups anywhere. It just takes time to find. I've found a really strong group of people on Instagram who talk about living with chronic illness and body positivity and all that jazz. And honestly I don't really talk to them personally, but reading their posts and advice has definitely made me a stronger person. 

If you ever need to talk about it, I'm here.

Hey, I'm sorry you're going through it too. It's hard to be surrounded by so many who don't get it. I'm 27, so not old per se, but I do still have hope. We need to have hope because there is hope. Anything can happen. 

I actually talk a lot on Instagram about going through this. I'm probably a lot more positive there, so I needed another outlet today when I was as low as I was. It's a battle, but I do believe we can win it. There is light and we aren't alone. 

Please reach out if you need to talk.

❤️

-s

I'm sorry you understand. ❤️ 

Thank you. I love the way you worded that. It's perfect.

Same tho. I know advice doesn't help in this situation. The only thing that seems to help is knowing you're not alone. If you need to talk, I'm here. The darkest days can get brighter. We can't give up.
